title: Cannabis Glandular Trichomes: A Cellular Metabolite Factory
authors: Research authors as indexed in PubMed Central
notes: Use for cannabis glandular-trichome structure, development and metabolite storage. Supports distinguishing stalked, sessile and bulbous glandular trichomes and the concentration of stalked glandular trichomes on mature female inflorescence tissues. Do not use visible trichome morphology alone as a direct quantitative proxy for cannabinoid concentration or harvest readiness.
